faq.answer: Cardholder should dispute within issuer window (typically 60 days from statement date) and keep supporting docs.
Mark as 'Disputed — Awaiting Resolution' and include support documentation.

rules.source_quote: The Corporate Card is issued for business expenses only.
All charges must be supported by itemized receipts per TEP-007.
Cash advances are prohibited on the Corporate Card except where authorized for international travel.
Personal purchases, gambling/adult entertainment/political contributions, and purchases for family/friends/third parties are prohibited.
Alcohol in violation of TEP-003 remains prohibited on Corporate Card.
Fraudulent/error charges must be disputed with issuer within the dispute window (typically 60 days).
Disputed charges should be marked 'Disputed — Awaiting Resolution' with supporting documentation.
